matrix_name: Indian Securities Market Investor Grievance Escalation Framework
regulatory_framework: SEBI Investor Grievance Redressal Mechanism & Online Dispute Resolution (SMART ODR)
disclaimer: This escalation matrix outlines verified official grievance pathways under Indian securities market norms. Internal deadlines or elapsed windows tracked by FlowGuard are demo configurations for simulation purposes and not statutory determinations.

tiers.entity_description: First point of complaint - Broker, Depository Participant, or Mutual Fund AMC
tiers.action: File grievance directly with the intermediary's online portal or designated grievance email.
tiers.expected_outcome: Acknowledgement with ticket ID, followed by internal investigation and written response.
tiers.notes: Always preserve the acknowledgement receipt and complaint reference ID.

tiers.entity_description: Stock Exchanges (NSE, BSE, MCX) and Depositories (CDSL, NSDL)
tiers.action: If the intermediary fails to respond or gives an unsatisfactory response, approach the relevant MII's Investor Grievance Cell.
tiers.expected_outcome: Exchange/Depository facilitates conciliation between investor and member.
tiers.notes: MIIs maintain Investor Service Centres (ISCs) across India.

tiers.entity_description: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) centralized grievance system
tiers.action: Lodge an online complaint on SEBI SCORES 2.0 if the complaint remains unresolved.
tiers.expected_outcome: Automated 2-tier routing with designated Action Taken Report (ATR) tracking.
tiers.notes: Mandatory requirement: Investor must have first approached the intermediary.

tiers.level_name: Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) - SMART ODR Portal
tiers.entity_description: Independent conciliation and arbitration through SEBI-recognized ODR institutions
tiers.action: Initiate dispute resolution on SMART ODR if grievance remains unresolved after Tier 1 / Tier 2.
tiers.expected_outcome: Conciliation by neutral conciliator; if unresolved, online arbitration by independent arbitrator.
tiers.notes: Fully digital, multi-lingual, and binding under Indian Arbitration & Conciliation Act.
